name: Art forms
text: Kathakali is a classical dance-drama with elaborate make-up; short shows for visitors run nightly in Fort Kochi and Thekkady, often with a chance to watch the make-up being applied. Theyyam is a powerful ritual art in North Malabar, performed in village shrines. Koodiyattam, a Sanskrit theatre form, is recognised by UNESCO.
tips: Arrive early at Kathakali to see the make-up
At Theyyam, dress modestly, keep distance and ask before photographing
Kerala Kalamandalam near Thrissur offers visitor programmes
